metadata.name: TM
metadata.description: Ticketmaster account generator: signup -> email verification -> SMS verification, then re-reads the saved email in account settings to confirm the account exists before saving it.

inputs.label: One account per address and email
inputs.hint: Creates and verifies one Ticketmaster account per run, then saves it to the Database. Pair addresses on Identity with emails on Email; Run limit on the Email tab caps how many emails this batch takes, and Order shuffles them first. The SMS tab picks the number provider, its service and country, and the price cap.
